policy.purpose: Record reviewed taxonomy corrections and distinct-concept decisions discovered during q011 canonical identity closure.

type_overrides.reason: record definition identifies a drywall joint reinforcement material, not a tool
form tie is a formwork spacing/tie component
formwork separator is a spacing component used with form ties and cones
rebar spacer block is a cover-maintaining component
tile spacer is a small spacing consumable/material rather than a tool
duplicate plural tile-spacer record represents the same spacing material
record definition identifies a flashing building component, not a tool
record definition identifies waterproof sealing tape material
full-body harness is fall-protection safety equipment
record definition identifies grout as a building material/consumable
record definition identifies a protective sheet/drop cloth material
access panel is an installed openable inspection component

alias_removals.reason: 野縁 and 胴縁 are related furring members but not canonical-equivalent Japanese terms
tie wire is the material used by the tying tool, not an alias of the tool
Screeding is the process; Screed is the tool/straightedge
firestop sealant is one product subtype within the broader firestop system/material family
generic wall/ceiling access panel should not alias the floor-specific inspection-hatch canonical
a planned construction joint is distinct from an unintended cold-joint defect
repair mortar is a specific mortar subtype, not an equivalent name for the broader repair-patch material family

resolved_distinct_pairs.reason: 野縁 is ceiling furring; 胴縁 is wall/backing furring. Related members, not the same canonical concept.
養生シート is overloaded: q011 is curing/drying-control context; protective_sheet is finish/floor surface protection.
curing sheet and drop cloth/protection sheet serve different site functions despite shared Japanese wording.
結束線 is consumable wire; rebar_tying_tool is the tool that twists/applies it.
Screeding is the leveling process; Screed is the tool/straightedge used for it.
firestop is the broader rated penetration treatment/material system; firestop sealant is one sealant subtype.
q011 is specifically an underfloor inspection hatch; access_panel covers wall/ceiling service access.
cold joint is an undesirable defect from delayed placement; construction joint is a planned/formed pour joint.
repair mortar is a mortar subtype; repair_patch is the broader repair-material family.
